title: 専門ゼミ
subtitle: Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III
educationalGoal: In Design Project III, students will learn the educational goals of the Department of Applied Bioscience. In the Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III, students review safety education and engineering ethics education. Furthermore, students learn how to implement the project activities and learn basic knowledge as engineers in the field of science and engineering.
advice:
In this course students prepare for their graduation research to be conducted in Design Project III. Students clarify their research objectives and build an experiment plan in Design Project III. Students also prepare a learning plan to acquire knowledge and skills necessary for carrying out their research.

Students analyze the research theme and summarize:
1)	Background
2)	Problem extraction
3)	Objective setting
4)	Methods of experiment and analysis
5)	Anticipated results

Students are required to present of their results in Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III, and submit reports as necessary.
requiredKnowledge: Details of Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III will be explained in the guidance for each laboratory.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course students prepare for their graduation research to be conducted in Design Project III. Students clarify their research objectives and build an experiment plan in Design Project III. Students also prepare a learning plan to acquire knowledge and skills necessary for carrying out their research.

Students analyze the research theme and summarize:
1)	Background
2)	Problem extraction
3)	Objective setting
4)	Methods of experiment and analysis
5)	Anticipated results

Students are required to present of their results in Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III, and submit reports as necessary.
